stories.title: McGuinty investigating after Poilievre said nurse’s job threatened over photo
stories.summary: Poilievre said his privilege as a MP was breached when a nurse was told she might lose her job after she was photographed speaking with him at the Wainwright base.

stories.title: B.C. Lions want to own or operate home stadium
stories.summary: B.C. Lions owner Amar Doman says the CFL team is interested in owning or operating BC Place, its home stadium in Vancouver.

stories.title: Stampeders hire Thorpe to run defence
stories.summary: The Calgary Stampeders have hired Noel Thorpe as the team's new defensive co-ordinator and defensive backs coach, the CFL team announced Thursday.

stories.title: CFL announces Vancouver as host of 2029 Grey Cup
stories.summary: When the B.C. Lions put forward a bid to bring the Grey Cup back to Vancouver, they took inspiration from another major sporting event — the FIFA World Cup.

stories.title: Smith hopes to leave separatism behind as UCP meets after divisive referendum
stories.summary: Premier Danielle Smith says she hopes to leave the issue of separatism in the rear-view mirror and have her UCP regroup to win next year's provincial election.

stories.title: CFB Wainwright burn victims face ‘long and challenging’ mental, physical recovery
stories.summary: A U of A reconstructive surgeon says soldiers still being treated for burns from the fire at CFB Wainwright have a long recovery ahead of them — both physically and mentally.

stories.title: Shooting at the auto shop: how Canada is tackling India’s extortion gangs
stories.summary: Documents obtained by Global News give a rare inside look at an investigation into an extortion scheme.

stories.title: Pierre Poilievre says Alberta nurse may lose job after photo with him in Wainwright
stories.summary: Pierre Poilievre said a nurse working on contract at the CFB Wainwright has been told she might lose her job after she was photographed speaking with him after the tragedy.

stories.title: Layoffs, programs cancelled as Calgary drops mental health funds from city budget
stories.summary: Calgary's proposed four-year budget doesn't continue mental-health funding for community groups, which has forced some organizations to eliminate programs and lay off staff.

stories.title: New Alberta riding maps pass in legislature as NDP MLA kicked out of debate
stories.summary: Deputy NDP leader Rakhi Pancholi was escorted out of question period for what her party says was a calling out of the UCP's gerrymandering as 'cheating' to win the next election.
